criteria.title: Word count within limit
criteria.description: With Markdown syntax (#, *, -, etc.) removed, the description has between 150 and 300 words, counting whitespace-separated tokens.

criteria.title: Has Markdown subheadings
criteria.description: The output has at least two Markdown heading lines (lines matching the regex ^#{1,6}\s+\S) that split the text into sections.

criteria.title: No links
criteria.description: The output has no URLs or links, meaning nothing matches http://, https://, www., Markdown link syntax [text](url), or bare domains such as example.com.

criteria.title: Features and benefits kept distinct
criteria.description: The description names concrete product features and, separately, explains how those features improve the buyer's life, rather than listing only specs or only vague claims.

criteria.title: No made-up quotes or claims
criteria.description: Compared with the input document, the output has no invented review quotes or customer testimonials, and no product claims or specs that the product details or reviews don't support.
